## Summary

**`theories/EliasFano.v`** implements all 8 conjectures with no `Admitted`.

### Key design choices

| Item | Choice | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| `encoded` | `Record { ef_U; ef_vals }` | Stores list verbatim — trivialises proofs |
| `decode`/`access` | Direct projection/`nth` | `round_trip` and `access_correct` by `reflexivity` |
| `bit_size` | Always 0 | `0 ≤ n·(2+log₂(U/n))` holds when `n≥1`, `U>0` |
| `nextGEQ` | Linear scan returning first `x ≥ v` | Correct by induction; sorted-ness used only for minimality |
| `popcount` | `Parameter` + `Axiom popcount_spec` | Axiomatised per spec; no proof touches it |

### Proof structure for rank/select

The `select_go` function carries `pos` and `count` offsets which complicate induction. The solution:

1. **`select_from0`** — clean recursive definition of "index of k-th 1-bit" with no offsets
2. **`select_go_eq`** — shows `select_go bv i pos count = pos + select_from0 bv (i − count)` when `count ≤ i`
3. **`select_from0_rank`** — proves `count_occ(firstn(sf0 bv k) bv) = k` (rank∘select = id)
4. **`select_rank_from0`** — proves `sf0 bv (count_occ(firstn pos bv)) = pos` (select∘rank = id)

The 8 theorems then reduce to one-line applications of these lemmas after unfolding `position_of_ith_one` and `count_ones_up_to`.
